Preparing for signed Windows downloads. Nothing changes in how Bookbench works.

## Changed

- New pages in the repository: [privacy](PRIVACY.md) (what Bookbench sends where - only on request, apart from the update check), [code signing policy](CODE_SIGNING.md) and [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- *Help > Costs and privacy* now lists every connection, including the update check.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy, or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.0.2.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
